notes.content:
This Update brings two tweakable color filters: "B/W" and "HUE"

[previewyoutube=Y6XbBFaEOt0;full][/previewyoutube]
B/W shrinks color value amplitude then makes it desaturated.
HUE shifts all screen colors.

You can switch between several presets during the game:

 【﻿Ｄｉｍ】 (default)
limits the brightest values of the screen. Cares about your 👀 better than the rest.
For 'original colors' use "Null Null" preset;

 【﻿Ｄｉｍ　ｗｉｔｈ　ｈｉｇｈｌｉｇｈｔｓ】
dims a screen but leaves the brightest values. Might help with better projectile tracking;

 【﻿Ｈａｌｆ－Ｄｉｍ】

 【﻿Ｎｕｌｌ　Ｎｕｌｌ】 vanilla settings;

 【﻿Ｍｏｎｏｃｈｒｏｍｅ】

 【﻿Ｄｅｓａｔｕｒａｔｅｄ】

 【﻿Ｒａｎｄｏｍ】 randomizes screen colors on each pick;


or find your personal favorite tuning and store it in a 【﻿Ｃｕｓｔｏｍ】 slot.

notes.title: 【﻿ＮＥＷＳ】 THE MAC VERSION REVEALED, BUGFIXES, OST KEYS, TRADING CARDS
notes.content:
Hello!

We've got some news.

THE MAC VERSION OF PUSS! IS OUT!

Finally, it is out!
Linux users, we still need a little more time before releasing a Linux version, stay tuned for updates.

MAJOR BUGS FIXES IN V.1.087

A new build, 1.087 is out. We tried our best to fix the most critical bugs like softlocking, stucking on some boss levels, improper work of trigger buttons and some achievements issues.
If you still face the named above bugs, please tell us HERE

ALL OST DLC KEYS ARE NOW SENT

We finally sent all 10000 OST DLC keys! Please, check your inbox.

TRADING CARDS

You often ask where are PUSS! trading cards.
The answer is they are all made and waiting to be released by Steam. PUSS! needs a little more time before Steam will allow to release cards. Spreading the word about the game should probably speed up this process.
